drugs.name: Atorvastatin
drugs.mechanism: Competitive inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase upregulating hepatic LDL receptors
drugs.efficacy: Reduces LDL-C by 40-60% and significantly reduces major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE)
drugs.adverse_effects: Myalgia, dyspepsia, headache, transaminase elevation, rare rhabdomyolysis

drugs.name: Evolocumab
drugs.mechanism: Fully human monoclonal antibody binding PCSK9, preventing LDLR lysosomal degradation and clearing circulating LDL
drugs.efficacy: Reduces LDL-C by ~60% on top of maximally tolerated statins and prevents MI/stroke
drugs.adverse_effects: Nasopharyngitis, upper respiratory tract infection, injection site erythema, back pain

drugs.name: Inclisiran
drugs.mechanism: Double-stranded small interfering RNA causing targeted catalytic breakdown of PCSK9 mRNA in hepatocytes
drugs.efficacy: Sustained ~50% LDL-C reduction with twice-yearly maintenance dosing
drugs.adverse_effects: Injection site reaction, arthralgia, urinary tract infection, bronchitis

drugs.name: Ezetimibe
drugs.mechanism: Potent inhibitor of Niemann-Pick C1-Like 1 (NPC1L1) transporter reducing intestinal cholesterol absorption
drugs.efficacy: Provides complementary ~15-20% incremental LDL-C lowering when combined with statins
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, upper respiratory tract infection, fatigue, arthralgia

drugs.name: Bempedoic Acid
drugs.mechanism: Inhibitor of ATP-citrate lyase (ACLY) upstream of HMG-CoA reductase activated exclusively in the liver
drugs.efficacy: Lowers LDL-C in statin-intolerant patients without causing statin-associated muscle symptoms
drugs.adverse_effects: Hyperuricemia, acute gout exacerbations, tendon rupture, elevated serum creatinine
